PHONE-FREE LEARNING ACROSS THE UK

Since 2014, we have led the charge to create phone-free schools, supporting hundreds of thousands of pupils across the United Kingdom every day. With UK based expert support and implementation, Yondr is proud to work with schools to help pupils experience the focus, creativity, and relief that comes with a phone-free education.

Why schools trust Yondr

Used globally across education and entertainment, we’re the gold standard in phone-free

  • The world's oldest and largest phone-free programme

  • Millions of students every day, worldwide

  • In every major arena globally

  • 20m people have been to a Yondr show

  • Over a decade developing our pouch

The Yondr Pouch - the next generation

  • ENHANCED LOCKING MECHANISM - Now the strongest pin on the market.

  • GREATER DURABILITY- Reinforced construction to reduce wear.

OUR LEADING APPROACH

At Yondr, we believe the pouch is just one piece of the puzzle. The Yondr Phone-Free Schools Programme includes a suite of resources designed to ensure a seamless transition, based on 10+ years experience working with thousands of educators around the world.

Our leading approach empowers schools:

  • Policy Consultation and Development

  • Operational Planning and Equipment

  • Training and Ongoing Support

Our unique, lockable pouch means students keep their phones, but cannot access them during the school day. Teachers no longer have to be the phone police, and pupils get a much needed 6-8 hour break from digital distractions.
